sources.title: T5Gemma 2 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: T5Gemma 2 T5Gemma 2 is a family of pretrained encoder-decoder large language models with strong multilingual, multimodal and long-context capability, available in 270M-270M, 1B-1B and 4B-4B parameters.
